COORDINATION
CITY OF CHICAGO HEIGHTS
PARK DISTRICT
concerning
ROOSEVELT SCHOOL PROPERTY
A meeting was held on Monday evening, December 16, 1974, with the City of Chicago Heights Park District. The purpose of the meeting was to explain the Lincoln Highway improvement in relation to Section 4(f) land procedures and early coordination correspondence received from the U.S. Department of Interior concerning the Park District as "...the officials having responsibility for providing recreational opportunities to the community".
A request for the Park District's concurrence in the findings reached by the Superintendent of Schools (Chicago Heights, District No. 170, Cook County) in his letter of August 30,1974, was presented. The playfield area was discussed in its role as, "...not significant to the recreational needs of the community".
It was decided, at the meeting, that the Park District would contact the School District and the City of Chicago Heights to verify the replacement scheme; and then would again consider the matter of "non-significance". Because of the time required for review and upon consideration of their regular scheduled meetings, the Park District Board promised to have a response within thirty (30) days.
Upon receipt of response from the Park District, it will replace this page; and appropriate documentation and text material will be revised appropriately, prior to submission to FHWA for signature of adoption.
